race.comment: ZIPPING COLUMBUS (7) was in the placings last time but shapes well for this on his superb win the start prior, getting around Warrnambool over 450m in 25.04. Has the ability and expected to go close again. OPAWA SCOOTER (4) recorded the quickest win on the program at this track last time, jumping from this box to claim a Grade 4 win in 22.88. Rates a key player again. PAW DIPPY (2) comes into this as a quickest on the card winner last time at Geelong, scoring by 3.5 lengths (25.78). Harder here but expected to measure up. SON OF WITCHY (1) can feature with the right run.
